name: PlayNav
description: Alpha. Pokemon-Amie and Super Training from X, Y, Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire on a DS-style touch screen (split screen, or a second display such as the AYN Thor). Pet your Pokemon, feed it Poke Puffs, play the Amie minigames, decorate its room and train its EVs. Gen 3 only.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon Alpha Sapphire (USA) Rev 2, decrypted .cci
optional_imports.description: Supplies the 3DS art and English text for Pokemon-Amie and Super Training, unpacked on your device. Optional: without it, simple drawn shapes and PlayNav's own wording are used. The copy can be removed from Imported files once the art has been extracted.
